questions.name: q2_where_is_toilet
questions.question: Where is the toilet?
questions.answer: The restrooms are located at the far end of the first-floor terrace. To reach them, please walk through the passage behind the reception desk to access the terrace directly. They feature Western-style toilets with warm-water bidets.
